complaints.description: Visitor RFID card dispenser jamming at main entrance kiosk.
Faded parking slot line markings near Visitor Bay 6 need repainting.
Garbage chute jammed on Block B 5th floor, waste accumulation.
Clubhouse central AC unit tripping main distribution breaker repeatedly.
Drainage blockage near basement P1 parking slot 14 causing water pooling.
Basement P2 driveway speed breaker loose bolts creating clanking noise.
Stairwell cobwebs accumulating near Block C emergency exit windows.
EV charging station Bay 4 displaying red ground fault indicator.
Loud music coming from clubhouse hall past 10:00 PM quiet hours.
Spilled motor oil in Basement P1 slot 42 requires degreasing cleaning.
Intercom unit not ringing in A-504 when visitors check in at gate.
Stray dog entered compound through broken boundary fence gap.
Elevator emergency intercom button unresponsive in Block A Lift 2.
Basement P2 lighting panel switch malfunctioning, east zone dark.
Dirty elevator mirrors and scuffed flooring in Lift 2 Block A.
Basement ramp convex safety mirror cracked and needs replacement.
Pigeon droppings on clubhouse open terrace lounge seating area.
Corroded valve tap leaking continuously in 2nd floor common washroom.
Badminton court synthetic matting peeling off near baseline.
Table tennis net torn in community recreation room.
Sump pump making loud grinding noise during automated filling cycle.
Low water pressure in Block A 4th floor master bathroom during morning hours.
Night security guard missed 3:00 AM patrol checkpoint scan.
Broken lawn sprinkler flooding walking track near North Gate entry.
Basement P1 ventilation fan duct vibration noise near slot 28.
Elevator ventilation exhaust fan producing squeaking noise.
Block C main elevator floor digital display showing error E-04.
Swings in kids play area showing rust at chain connection joints.
Service lift ceiling bulb burned out inside Block B service shaft.
CCTV Camera #8 facing podium garden offline since 1:00 AM.
Unidentified commercial van parked overnight in resident spot B-12.
Exhaust fan in generator room stopped spinning completely.
Water dripping from AC condensate pipe onto car in slot A-105.
Flickering corridor lights on Block C 3rd floor creating safety concern.
Lift keypad buttons for 7th and 8th floors stuck when pressed.
Elevator #1 in Block B making jerky movements between 2nd and 3rd floors.
Gym treadmill belt slipping during operation on Unit 2.
Children playground sand pit area needs clearing and sifting.
Main overhead water tank outlet pipe leaking near Block B stairway landing.
Continuous water seepage from ceiling in C-302 guest bedroom corner.
Bicycle storage rack full with abandoned bikes blocking walkway.
Unassigned vehicle parked illegally in reserved disabled slot near foyer.
Pedestrian side gate magnetic lock failing to latch securely.
Substation main circuit breaker tripped twice during evening peak hours.
Main Gate boom barrier optical sensor sluggish, delaying entry.
Emergency staircase exit sign battery backup light unlit on 6th floor.
Lift door safety sensor re-opening doors repeatedly on ground floor.
Overflowing dry recycling bin near Gate 2 security cabin.

notices.title: ⚠️ Emergency Water Supply Maintenance Notice
notices.body: Overhead tank cleaning and main valve maintenance scheduled for tomorrow between 10:00 AM and 2:00 PM. Please store water accordingly.

notices.title: 🚨 Annual Fire Safety & Alarm Drill
notices.body: Full society fire alarm testing and evacuation drill will take place on Saturday at 11:00 AM. Attendance is strongly encouraged for all residents.

notices.title: 🌿 Monthly Society General Body Meeting
notices.body: The monthly resident association meeting will be held in the Clubhouse Hall this Sunday at 5:00 PM. Agenda includes green waste management and solar panel installation.

notices.title: ⚡ EV Charging Station Bay 4 Upgrade
notices.body: New fast-charging cables have been installed at Basement P1 EV Kiosk 4. Please report any operational issues via the resident portal.

notices.title: 🏊 Swimming Pool Maintenance Hours
notices.body: The swimming pool will be closed every Monday morning from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM for routine chemical balancing and filtration system backwashing.

notices.title: 🎉 Festive Cultural Evening & Children Talent Show
notices.body: Join us for the upcoming society cultural evening! Registration for children talent performances is open at the security office until Thursday.
